open_grading_criteria: Core requested facts/differences complete; material technical and absence claims supported by actual cited prepared evidence; no unrequested performance superiority drift. Extra supported context can be accepted when clearly bounded. Rubric axes are judged separately; overall correctness is not inferred by score threshold.
same_ai_curation_and_grading_limit: AI-curated references and AI-assisted output review are not independent human Gold or blind human evaluation; strict grounding/scope judgments are inspectable and may differ between reviewers.
